info.name: Luden - Il re del quartiere a luci rosse
info.plot: Ispirato a fatti realmente accaduti, l'epopea gangsteristica LUDEN racconta l'ascesa della Nutella Gang, il più famoso cartello di protettori della leggendaria Reeperbahn di Amburgo negli anni '80. L'insolito cartello trasforma il rude quartiere a luci rosse di St. Pauli in un luogo affascinante, ma è anche l'inizio di una lotta per il potere con i magnaccia affermati della GMBH.

episodes.name: Jumbo Jet
episodes.plot: Klaus wants to rise to the top. When he meets the prostitute Jutta, his goal seems to be within his grasp, but he has to face Jutta's pimp, Beatle. Helped by his friends Andy and Bernd, he must prove himself and confront the established pimps of the GMBH.

episodes.name: Eros Center
episodes.plot: Klaus, Jutta, Andy and Bernd want to start their own cartel. To have a chance at getting his own floor at the Eros Center, Klaus makes a momentous deal with the godfather of the red-light district, Frida Schulz. Manu makes new friends and meets police officer Hansen. Will he help her find her mother?

episodes.name: Andis Bruder
episodes.plot: Klaus turns his floor at the Eros Center into a glamorous venue. While his business is thriving, that of the GMBH is suffering. The rivalry escalates into a man-to-man fistfight. Manu is to perform a show dance at the Flamingo and finds her true talent.

episodes.name: Rambazamba
episodes.plot: Manu and Jutta meet, but Jutta does not want to face her responsibilities. Klaus is at the peak of his success and makes a powerful enemy. He gets into trouble with Frida Schulz.

episodes.name: Gran Canaria
episodes.plot: The AIDS wave hits St. Pauli and business collapses. Klaus puts all his eggs in one basket. Manu gets closer to Beatle, who pursues his own agenda.

episodes.name: Weiße Dame
episodes.plot: To get his hands on money again, Klaus gets involved in the cocaine business. But when a big deal goes south, the war with the GMBH escalates. Klaus must decide what is more important to him, his business or Jutta.
